items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: And Otto Hardwick and Freddy Guy. Of course, he died, he was a guitar player.

ctx.x: And Otto Hardwick and Freddy Guy. Of course, he died, he was a guitar player. And Tricky Sam was on trombone. Yeah, he died, too. And Bro, Bro was on bass.
Yeah. Well, I guess Sonny is the only one left.
